lines.text: Brothers are asked not to be easily alarmed by any message seeming to be from us, alleging the Day has come.
The man of lawlessness will seat himself in the temple of Babylon, proclaiming himself to be God.
The restrainer continues until he is taken out of the way, and then the Lord Jesus will slay the lawless one.
The lawless one will come with the working of Satan, and judgment will fall on those who delighted in wickedness.
God chose the Thessalonians from the day of Pentecost, so they should stand firm and cling to the traditions.
